sources.cite: Backstage documentation, The Life of an Entity
sources.note: Read 2026-11-17 with WebFetch (a summarizing fetch) of the primary page, found by WebSearch. Confirms: an entity whose processing emits errors does not replace its last error-free version and carries the problem in its status; an entity becomes orphaned when its parent no longer emits it; the catalog removes orphans automatically by default, and orphanStrategy: keep turns that off, after which orphans are deleted through the API or the entity page.

Read 2026-11-17 with WebFetch (a summarizing fetch) of the primary page, found by WebSearch. Confirms: the GitHub entity provider's organization and schedule (frequency, timeout); GitHub's limit of 5,000 API requests an hour, which frequent refreshes exhaust; events support refreshing entities from push and repository webhooks through the events backend module for GitHub.

The company, the repositories, the services and the people are fictional. The minutes or days each step takes and the effects of each decision are teaching simplifications for exam practice, not measured values.

brief.situation: You run the developer portal at Corvant Logistics, a fictional shipping company. Its catalog is fed by GitHub discovery over 600 repositories. Teams report 40 services missing, stale entries for repositories that were archived, and the security team needs the ownership list for an audit tomorrow.
handover: Ingestion: the GitHub discovery provider, scanning catalog-info.yaml in every repository.
A migration last week moved 35 repositories to a new organization.
howItWorks: The terminal shows each command's output; the map shows each component and its status in words.
Move on a check-in at a time. A decision comes to you at each check-in; before the first, you can read the evidence.
At the end you write the record and a short reflection.

then.log: Check-in 2: entities with invalid names break the search index; search returns nothing for an hour.
Check-in 3: the rebuild is a third done; manually registered systems and groups are gone, and the audit list cannot be produced.

schemaPrompt.title: 37 entities fail validation
schemaPrompt.context: 31 have an apiVersion typo; 6 have invalid names.

choices.label: Open pull requests fixing apiVersion and metadata.name in the 37 catalog-info.yaml files, and fix the template they were copied from

effects.log: The fixes merge; the next refresh ingests them.

choices.feedback: The entity files are the source of truth; fixing them and the template stops the error coming back.

choices.label: Register the 37 services by hand in the UI with corrected YAML pasted in
choices.feedback: They appear, but the repositories still hold broken files, and the hand-made entries drift from them.

choices.label: Add a custom processor that accepts any apiVersion and skips name validation
choices.feedback: Invalid entities now enter the catalog and break the pages and plugins that rely on the schema.

orphansPrompt.title: 35 orphaned entities
orphansPrompt.context: The 35 moved repositories' old entities are marked orphaned: no location produces them any more. Their new locations are not scanned.

choices.label: Add the new organization to the discovery provider, check each orphan has a new entity, then delete the 35 orphans

effects.log: The new organization is scanned; the confirmed orphans are deleted.

choices.feedback: Fix the location first so the entities come back from their new home, then remove the orphans you confirmed.

choices.label: Add the new organization but keep the orphans for now

effects.log: The new organization is scanned; the orphans stay.

choices.feedback: Each moved service now appears twice, once orphaned, until someone cleans up.

choices.label: Delete every entity from the catalog database and let it rebuild
choices.feedback: The rebuild loses manually registered entities and takes hours; the audit list is not there tomorrow.

refreshPrompt.title: Changes take 30 minutes to show
refreshPrompt.context: Discovery runs every 30 minutes. The GitHub app's rate limit is shared with CI.

choices.label: Keep the 30-minute discovery schedule and add GitHub push events so changed repositories refresh at once

effects.log: Push events refresh changed repositories at once.

choices.feedback: Event-driven refresh is fast without scanning 600 repositories more often.

choices.label: Tell teams to press 'Refresh' on their entity page after a change

effects.log: Teams are told to refresh by hand.

choices.feedback: It works for those who know, and nothing else changes.

choices.label: Set the schedule to every 10 seconds

effects.log: Discovery now scans 600 repositories every 10 seconds.

choices.feedback: Scanning 600 repositories every 10 seconds exhausts the shared rate limit; ingestion and CI both stop.

scoring.modelReasoning: Processing errors name the entity file and the rule it breaks: fix catalog-info.yaml (and the template it came from) instead of relaxing validation or registering copies by hand. Entities whose location no longer produces them become orphans; fix ingestion so the moved repositories are discovered, confirm the new entities, then delete the orphans, never the whole catalog. Refresh on a schedule the integration's rate limit allows, and use events for speed.
